question:
Which term from among the given options can replace the question mark (?) in the following series to make it logically complete?

QX 10, ?, WD 30, ZG 26, CJ 130
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : 

 
• First and second letter → (3) is added to the position value according to English alphabetic series.
 
• Number → Alternately (4) is subtracted and multiplied by (5) to each number subsequently.

So,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cf6cf9df7e1f9c4301a11671f559666875ff18670837305ebd80b7da6e9312d1.png] 

​Hence, "TA 6" is the correct answer.
